answer: Make each identity solve a memory-hard puzzle every epoch, seeded from the previous block hash so nothing can be precomputed. The cost scales with RAM rather than cleverness, so an operator who wants to forge five hundred agents needs five hundred machines' worth of memory in every window. For an honest agent the fee is as small as a scribe's quill; for a farm the bill spirals with each clone it keeps, since memory can't be time-sliced inside the window.
